correction: The pricing paper described the competitor panel as 43 part numbers from one source, 16.5% of the book. That is the KS panel alone.

eucon_crossref_iam_20260329.csv holds a part-number-level cross-reference to 432 IAM part numbers and 155 brands with a real price on all 822 rows, and had never been joined. It is a richer base than the panel the paper was built on.
The union with a USABLE PRICE is the number that matters. The larger union that includes the Autodoc extract must not be quoted as coverage, because that source has no usable price.
caveats: Price tiers differ and must never be blended: KS is GBP trade ex-VAT; Eucon/PartsPool is online IAM EUR in DE/NO. Both differ from the reference dealer price we compare against.
The Eucon crossref covers DE and NO only.

TecAlliance sells both the cross-reference (OE Parts Data) and the prices (OE Prices / IAM Prices) as licensed products. Whether the price module returns a competing retail price directly is unverified and needs a vendor demo.
